PLAN "Post-MI General Fitness — 12 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
GOAL primary cardiovascular_safety
name "Maintain HR below 115 bpm at all times; no Valsalva; no maximal effort"
END GOAL
GOAL secondary aerobic_base
name "Build sustainable aerobic capacity through moderate-intensity cardio"
END GOAL
GOAL tertiary functional_strength
name "Develop whole-body muscular endurance with light-to-moderate loads"
END GOAL
GOAL quaternary mobility
name "Maintain and improve joint mobility and flexibility"
END GOAL
END GOALS

PHASES
PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks)
WEEK 1
DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Strength A"
WARMUP
walking 8 minutes
arm_circles 60 seconds
leg_swings 60 seconds
hip_circles 60 seconds
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
seated_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
dumbbell_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
leg_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
plank 2x20 seconds rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
dead_bug 2x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
walking 5 minutes
hamstring_stretch 30 seconds
quad_stretch 30 seconds
hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
chest_stretch 30 seconds

END COOLDOWN
END DAY
